_comment: One object per project, rendered top to bottom in file order. paragraphs = description text; year (optional) shows beside the title; links = external links; docs = files in images/cs with a first-page thumbnail; video = a YouTube URL (optional).

projects.name: Synesthesia
projects.tagline: A colorful visual display driven wirelessly by digital piano input.
paragraphs: This project uses Google Chrome's built-in MIDI input driver as a cross-platform MIDI interface, and includes a web app that acts as the processor and light driver. The web app is written with Node.js, Express, and client-side JavaScript. Communication with the Philips Hue bulbs is done with REST calls from both the server and client.
By combining musical data and Philips Hue colored light bulbs, which can be controlled over your local wifi network, the colorful displays take on a new dimension.

projects.name: Muon g-2
projects.tagline: Monte Carlo simulations for a high-energy particle storage ring.
paragraphs: Programmed Monte Carlo simulations in C++ to optimize particle detector efficiency by 200%; proposed and optimized novel tungsten shielding to minimize particle interference.
Programmed Monte Carlo simulations in C++ to determine the optimal position of focusing magnets in a high energy particle storage ring, resulting in a 600% increase in the number of stored particles.

projects.name: BinderFilter
projects.tagline: A Linux kernel message firewall for Android.
paragraphs: BinderFilter is written as a kernel driver that implements reading, blocking, and modifying Android IPC messages. It acts as an Android equivalent of Linux Netfilter by re-injecting Android binder messages in the kernel layer.
